state_boundary.differential_bound: |d log(p_i/p_j)| <= sqrt(1/p_i+1/p_j) sqrt(dtheta^T F_Q dtheta); real full-support Born measurement, unfloored probabilities
state_boundary.finite_bound: Every pair gap changes by at most2 sqrt(1-|<psi|phi>|^2); p_(4)-p_(5) greater than this implies unchanged top4
state_boundary.product_overlap: <psi(theta)|psi(theta+delta)>=product cos(delta_j/2), for the same fixed real circuit after the product RY encoding
state_boundary.scope: A sufficient finite bound and a local differential bound, both independent of expert function costs. A probability floor rescales the gap and drift equally; arbitrary learned input encoders also contribute their Jacobian.
state_boundary.novelty: Own specialization/check of standard state-overlap and Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities; no novelty or advantage claim for the generic inequalities.

functional.equation: G_function(x)=V(x)^T J_head(x)^T [diag(p_LM)-p_LM p_LM^T] J_head(x) V(x); KL approximately(1/2) Delta_w^T G_function Delta_w
functional.notation: V has expert outputs as columns; code stores its transpose. Head Jacobian includes final LayerNorm. Sum(Delta_w)=0 gives common-output-shift invariance.
functional.distinction: Gate categorical Fisher diag(p_gate)-p_gate p_gate^T in logits and state QFI describe other maps. Equality to the functional metric requires additional expert/head structure.
functional.hard_selection: Within a fixed active set one can pull G_function through the weight Jacobian. Across a top-k exchange, directly measure the finite displacement or its labeled KL approximation; an ordinary derivative of hard indices omits the jump.
